applicabilityBasis.summary: Bera USD (BUSD), formerly HONEY, is marketed as a payment/remittance dollar stablecoin, but minting and redemption operate through HoneyFactory against whitelisted crypto collateral at governance-configured rates. The opened specification does not establish a legal issuer obligation to redeem for a fixed amount of monetary value; crypto-collateral redemption alone does not resolve the GENIUS definition.

references.label: Bera USD current collateral, minting and redemption specification

genius.notes: HONEY was renamed Bera USD (BUSD) on August 19, 2026 without changing contract 0xfcbd14dc51f0a4d49d5e53c2e0950e0bc26d0dce. Official documentation describes whitelisted crypto collateral, governance-configured mint/redeem rates and proportional basket redemption upon collateral depeg. Reserve and redemption disclosure presence refers to these published mechanics, not verified live balances, an attested reserve report or guaranteed fiat redemption. No monthly third-party examination was located. The existing Berachain Foundation (Cayman Islands) issuerEntity and Cayman Islands issuerDomicile are preserved as legacy attributions pending legal-issuer evidence; the reviewed token specification does not verify them. BERA airdrop terms identify Bera Chain Foundation for BERA only and cannot establish this stablecoin issuer. Deletion of the load-bearing issuerEntity is not accepted merely because its attribution remains unverified. Foreign-exception status remains unknown. Main-site terms and reserve interfaces returned HTTP 429 and browser extraction was unavailable; reserveDisclosureUrl therefore points to the accessible official specification. No public GENIUS-specific enforcement action was located in the bounded review.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official application, selected issuer pathway or foreign-issuer exception was located for Bera USD/BUSD, HONEY or Berachain as of 2026-10-07. The actual token-issuing legal entity remains unverified. Project governance and Foundation affiliation do not establish a PPSI or an enforceable monetary-value redemption obligation. This review does not concern Binance USD/BUSD or the BERA/USD native-token trading pair. The legacy issuerEntity/domicile remain unverified and are not relied upon as proof of token issuance or a foreign exception.
